cases.given: The new event supersedes part of current state but history must remain auditable.
cases.expect: Current state is corrected with a traceable transition.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a one-shot task has no state evolution
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Authority outranks recency unless the authoritative source explicitly delegates update power.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Stop dependent actions when a safety-critical contradiction cannot be resolved.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A later, higher-authority event contradicts one current field.
cases.expect: Apply an ordered, provenance-preserving delta and retain the old value as history.
cases.reject: Append both values to undifferentiated memory or rewrite all state.
